name: Flame Breath

parts.label: Active
parts.text: Active: Shyvana unleashes a fireball in the target direction that stops upon hitting an enemy champion, dealing magic damage to all enemies hit and marking them for 5 seconds.
Shyvana's basic attacks against marked enemies are empowered to deal bonus magic damage on-hit equal to 3% (+ 1% per 100 bonus AD) of the target's maximum health, capped at 150 against monsters.

mechanics.evidence: Shyvana's basic attacks against marked enemies are empowered to deal bonus magic damage on-hit equal to 3% (+ 1% per 100 bonus AD) of the target's maximum health, capped at 150 against monsters.

parts.label: Dragon Form Bonus
parts.text: Dragon Form Bonus: The fireball explodes upon hitting an enemy champion or reaching the target location, dealing increased magic damage and creating a scorched field for 4 seconds. Enemies within the field are marked once and dealt 20 / 24.1667 / 28.3333 / 32.5 / 36.6667 / 40.8333 / 45 / 49.1667 / 53.3333 / 57.5 / 61.6667 / 65.8333 / 70 / 74.1667 / 78.3333 (based on level) (+ 7.5% bonus AD) (+ 10% AP) magic damage every 0.5 seconds.

values.context: Enemies within the field are marked once and dealt 20 / 24.1667 / 28.3333 / 32.5 / 36.6667 / 40.8333 / 45 / 49.1667 / 53.3333 / 57.5 / 61.6667 / 65.8333 / 70 / 74.1667 / 78.3333 (based on level) (+ 7.5% bonus AD) (+ 10% AP) magic damage every 0.5 seconds.

notes:
The fireball applies area damage and the on-hit effect against marked targets deals proc damage.
  - In Dragon Form, the fiery explosion applies area damage and the burning scorch deals persistent area damage to all enemies within the area of effect.
In Dragon Form, both areas of effect will be centered on the first champion struck, not at the location the missile collided with them.
This ability will cast from wherever the caster is at the end of the cast time.
In Dragon Form, the visual mark will not be applied to non-champions, but the debuff will still be applied for gameplay purposes.
Magic damage on-hit can be dodged by dodging effects.

parts.label: Active

parts.label: Dragon Form Bonus
parts.text:

Upon hitting an enemy champion or large monster, and after reaching maximum range, the fireball sets an explosion upon the targets struck and at the location that applies the same effects. Enemies within a scorched field are dealt 3.75 / 5 / 6.25 (based on level) (+ 1.25% AP) magic damage every 0.25 seconds, for a total maximum damage of 30 / 40 / 50 (based on level) (+ 10% AP).

Enemies may be damaged by only one scorched field at a time. Subsequent explosions against the same target deal 40% damage.

name: Emberstrike

fields.cooldownStart: starts on-cast, but restarts each time an empowered attack is used

values.label: First attack cone height and second attack blast radius

parts.label: Passive
parts.text: Passive: Shyvana's basic attacks on-hit will reduce Emberstrike's current cooldown by 0.5 seconds, and deal bonus magic damage equal to 1% (+ 1.1% per 100 bonus AD) of the target's maximum health. Against non-champions, this effect deals a minimum of 10 and is capped at 200.

mechanics.evidence: Passive: Shyvana's basic attacks on-hit will reduce Emberstrike's current cooldown by 0.5 seconds, and deal bonus magic damage equal to 1% (+ 1.1% per 100 bonus AD) of the target's maximum health.

parts.label: Active
parts.text: Active: Emberstrike can be cast twice in Human Form and thrice in Dragon Form. Each cast empowers Shyvana's next basic attack within 6 seconds to have an uncancellable windup and trigger an additional exclusive effect. After 1.5 seconds of using an Emberstrike attack, or immediately following a basic attack, the ability can be recast within and up to the next 4 seconds each time, before it incurs its cooldown. Shyvana gains 50 bonus range on all of her basic attacks while Emberstrike is active. The attacks deal 10 bonus physical damage against monsters.

mechanics.evidence: Each cast empowers Shyvana's next basic attack within 6 seconds to have an uncancellable windup and trigger an additional exclusive effect.

parts.label: First Cast
parts.text: First Cast: Shyvana slashes her claws, blasting a cone in the target's direction that deals modified physical damage to enemies hit. The damage to the primary target is affected by critical strike modifiers.

mechanics.evidence: The damage to the primary target is affected by critical strike modifiers.

parts.label: Second Cast
parts.text: Second Cast: Shyvana slams her tail, dealing the same damage to the target and surrounding enemies.

parts.label: Dragon Form Bonus — Third Cast
parts.text: Dragon Form Bonus — Third Cast: Shyvana takes a bite out of the target, dealing modified true damage. This damage cannot critically strike.

mechanics.evidence: This damage cannot critically strike.

parts.text: All casts reset Shyvana's basic attack timer.

mechanics.evidence: All casts reset Shyvana's basic attack timer.

notes: Applies spell damage to the primary target (attack target) and area damage to secondary targets. The passive on-hit damage applies proc damage.
Spell shield will not block any damage nor be consumed by the strikes.
The true damage is always equal to 150% of the pre-mitigation physical damage.
Blind will negate the damage to the primary target, but not to any secondary targets.
Interaction with parrying effects (dodge, block).

Only the last cast of Emberstrike puts Shyvana's basic attack on cooldown.
  - In Human Form, only Q2 will put it on cooldown; in Dragon Form, only Q3 will.
  - This results in the same functionality as Shield of Daybreak and Thundering Smash, effectively being a triple/quintuple attack reset.

name: Dragon's Descent

parts.label: Passive - Fury
parts.text: Passive - Fury: Shyvana generates Dragon Fury every 0.5 seconds while in Human Form. Her basic attacks and abilities also generate 1.25 Dragon Fury for each enemy damaged, up to once per enemy per cast instance and increased by 200% during Dragon Form. Against non-champions damaged by abilities, the generated amount is reduced to 25%. Shyvana gains 1% bonus Dragon Fury generation from all sources per 1 ultimate haste. Shyvana gains 100 Dragon Fury upon learning Dragon's Descent.
